subject: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps — quick alignment
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@finvara.com>, Alex Morales <alex.morales@finvara.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps — quick alignment

Hi Priya / Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and an attached Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to help us lock owners and dates so we can move the evaluation forward. Highlights from our call:

- Goal: Run a 4-week evaluation to validate latency and cost profiles for your LLM-powered recommendation flow.
- Success criteria: median generation latency < 250ms, cost per 1k queries within your modeling budget, no PII persisted in logs.
- Redwood deliverables: evaluation environment, test harness, baseline performance report, and a lightweight integration guide.
- Finvara deliverables: test dataset subset, integration owner, and security contact.

Attached: Finvara-MutualActionPlan-v1.2.pdf (PDF, 145 KB) — the MAP already has suggested owners and target dates based on our conversation. Can you confirm the owners and the dates listed on the first page? If any of the proposed owners need to change, a single line reply with the name + updated target date is perfect.

Suggested immediate next steps:
- Confirm owners & dates in the MAP (reply-all)
- Optional: 30-min kick-off to walk the test harness (I can do June 16 or 17; let me know what works)

If the timeline is slipping or this isn’t a priority right now, just say so and we’ll pause outreach — no pressure.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
Schedule: https://cal.redwood.com/jonas

Attachment: Finvara-MutualActionPlan-v1.2.pdf

Checking in on the MAP I sent last week (below). I realize things get busy after vendor calls — wanted to surface three quick options so this is easy to action:

1) Confirm owners/dates in one-line reply (fastest)
2) Tell me to hold and we’ll reconnect in 2–3 weeks
3) Put Marissa (cc’d) on a short sync to finalize owners if that helps

If it helps, here’s the minimal info I need to unblock: who will own the integration, who will own security/ops, and a target kickoff date.

Thanks — I’ll hold off on chasing if you’d prefer a pause.

Best,
Jonas

- Integration owner: Alex Morales — target kickoff: 2027-06-23
- Security/ops owner: Priya Shah (me) — target review: 2027-06-25
